definitions.explanation: A casual and rough way to refer to a person. Can be neutral among close friends or derogatory depending on tone and context.
A casual way to refer to an object or thing, used instead of もの or の.

examples.japanese: ⟦あいつ→あいつ：08267_aitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧やつだ。
⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧やつ、⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧⟦{遅刻|ちこく}した→遅刻する：22282_chikokusuru⟧。
⟦{嘘|うそ}をつく→嘘をつく：21763_usowotsuku⟧やつ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{信用|しんよう}できない→信用する：25371_shinyousuru⟧。
examples.english: You can't trust someone who lies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧やつ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧。
⟦さっき→さっき：01264_sakki⟧⟦{話|はな}し→話す：00467_hanasu⟧てたやつ、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{売|う}り{切|き}れ→売り切れる：03012_urikireru⟧てた。
examples.english: The thing we were talking about earlier was already sold out.

notes:
REGISTER:
やつ is casual and can be rude depending on context. When referring to people:
- Friendly: ⟦あいつ→あいつ：08267_aitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧やつだ (He's a good guy)
- Hostile: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧やつ、⟦{許|ゆる}せない→許す：02325_yurusu⟧ (That jerk, I can't forgive him)

When referring to things (sense 2), やつ is simply casual with no negative connotation.

FORMS:
- ⟦こいつ→こいつ：08268_koitsu⟧: this guy (close/rude)
- ⟦そいつ→そいつ：08759_soitsu⟧: that guy (close/rude)
- ⟦あいつ→あいつ：08267_aitsu⟧: that guy over there (close/rude)

USAGE:
Not typically used in polite speech. Use ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧, ⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧, or もの instead.
